name: Omnix StreamRelay
author: admin@omnixstudio.com
description: Multistream relay + chat. Primary allocation = dashboard. Set RTMP_PORT and SRT_PORT to your other allocations. Image MUST exist on the Wings node: docker build -t omnix-streamrelay:latest -f pterodactyl/Dockerfile .

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
cd /mnt/server || true
mkdir -p data logs
printf '%s\n' \
'Omnix StreamRelay — install OK' \
'===============================' \
'If the panel stuck on Installing before: the egg image was missing on this node.' \
'On the Wings host (SSH), from the Live-Stream repo:' \
'  sudo docker build -t omnix-streamrelay:latest -f pterodactyl/Dockerfile .' \
'Then Start (or Reinstall once image exists).' \
'' \
'Ports (Ptero host port = container port):' \
'  Primary SERVER_PORT  = dashboard HTTP' \
'  Egg RTMP_PORT        = OBS RTMP (often 1935)' \
'  Egg SRT_PORT         = SRT UDP (often 8890)' \
'Set PUBLIC_HOST to the public DNS (e.g. mumbai.war67.online).' \
'Leave secrets as auto. Open FIRST_LOGIN.txt after start.' \
> README-OMNIX.txt
date -u > .omnix-installed
sync
echo Install complete
exit 0

variables.name: Public Host
variables.description: DNS or public IP shown in FIRST_LOGIN / OBS URLs (e.g. abudhabi.war67.online).

variables.name: RTMP Port
variables.description: Must match your RTMP allocation port (container listens on this). Use 1935 if that allocation exists; else your extra TCP port (e.g. 19147).

variables.name: SRT Port
variables.description: Must match your SRT allocation (UDP preferred). Use 8890 if available; else your other extra port.

variables.name: Dashboard Port Override
variables.description: Leave empty to use primary allocation (SERVER_PORT). Only set if you need to force dashboard off the primary.

variables.name: Bootstrap Token
variables.description: Dashboard login password. Use auto to generate on first start (console + FIRST_LOGIN.txt).

variables.name: OBS Publish Password
variables.description: Internal/legacy. OBS auth is OFF — leave auto.

variables.name: Ingest Stream Key
variables.description: OBS stream key (path after /live/). Default mystream is fine.

variables.name: OPTIONAL Twitch Channel
variables.description: Leave EMPTY unless you want Twitch chat now.

variables.name: OPTIONAL YouTube Live Chat ID
variables.description: Leave EMPTY for now (video restream does not need this).
